profileReplacement: UpdateCandidate requires ProfileFieldMask. Only masked profile values are validated, fingerprinted, and updated; unmasked values, including SDK defaults, are ignored and preserved. A masked optional field clears when its input is omitted, null, empty, or whitespace; a masked non-empty value is validated and set. Masked CandidateName or CandidateEmail omission, null, or blank is rejected with REQUIRED_TEXT.

profileFieldMaskContract.syntax: Case-sensitive comma-separated field names with no whitespace, duplicates, empty tokens, or unknown names.
profileFieldMaskContract.nonUpdateMask: Nonempty masks are rejected as PROFILE_FIELD_MASK_NOT_APPLICABLE; null or empty defaults are ignored.
profileFieldMaskContract.maskedMissingOptionalValue: Clears optional fields; CandidateName and CandidateEmail omission is rejected with REQUIRED_TEXT.
profileFieldMaskContract.maskedOptionalBlankText: CandidatePhone and CandidateCvUrl empty or whitespace values normalize to clear.
profileFieldMaskContract.maskedGuidEmpty: Clears the selected PositionId, CandidateSourceId, or AssignedTaId lookup; absent, null, and Guid.Empty are equivalent masked clear representations with one fingerprint. Unmasked Guid.Empty is ignored and preserved.
profileFieldMaskContract.legacyReceiptCompatibility: Version 1 maskless UpdateCandidate receipts replay only when the new request's legacy-equivalent normalized fingerprint matches. Receipts are not rewritten; changed fields or values conflict.

optionalProfileLookupTransport: ProfileFieldMask is authoritative in the source contract. Unmasked values, including Guid.Empty lookup defaults, are ignored and preserved; a masked lookup omitted, explicitly null, or Guid.Empty clears, because Dataverse can materialize an omitted optional Guid input as Guid.Empty; malformed non-Guid lookup values are rejected. The offline SDK harness covers all five optional profile clears by omission, unmasked defaults, invalid masked lookups, and the full 21-input shape, including the live-shaped masked Assigned TA Guid.Empty clear. The exact approved mask-plus-omission corrective package was submitted once in the owner-authorized controlled DEV overwrite on 2026-11-05; PAC success and exact topology were reconciled, without claiming server-byte equality. One owner Console Assigned TA clear was intercepted before forwarding: exact five parameters, ProfileFieldMask=AssignedTaId, lookup and unchanged properties absent. The single dispatch returned HTTP 400 / 0x80040265; GET-only readback confirms no Candidate or durable business-row change. Runtime clear acceptance failed, with no retry or subsequent business write. Offline, the exact 21-input live shape with AssignedTaId=Guid.Empty reproduced INVALID_GUID_PARAMETER:AssignedTaId from the deployed rule; the live internal error category itself is not proven. Fingerprint version remains 1, with maskless receipt compatibility retained and tested.

schedulingEvidenceContract.source: Existing os_sr_intv Round 1 records are the authoritative durable scheduling evidence; do not require a separate external calendar system for these Candidate Core operations.
schedulingEvidenceContract.MarkRound1Scheduled: Requires Waiting Manual Scheduling, caller-readable active TA and Location references, and a valid future same-day UTC interval. Create or promote the durable schedule and read it back before Candidate, Status History, and Receipt writes.
schedulingEvidenceContract.RecordPass: Requires exactly one active Round 1 schedule with no terminal result. Persist result, timestamp, and notes before Candidate, Status History, and Receipt writes.
schedulingEvidenceContract.RecordFail: Requires exactly one active Round 1 schedule with no terminal result. Persist result, timestamp, and notes before Candidate, Status History, and Receipt writes.
schedulingEvidenceContract.RequestReschedule: Requires exactly one active Round 1 schedule with no terminal result and a reason. Supersede and read back the old schedule, create and read back the Proposed replacement, then write Candidate, Status History, and Receipt.
schedulingEvidenceContract.CancelRound1: Requires exactly one active Round 1 schedule with no terminal result and a reason. Cancel and read back the existing schedule before Candidate, Status History, and Receipt writes.
schedulingEvidenceContract.calendarBoundary: These manual scheduling records do not represent a calendar event booking. Separate email/calendar integrations continue to follow their approved identity, availability, and fail-closed rules.
